name: Café Sport
kurzbeschreibung: Welcome to Café Sport in Tirol – where tradition meets alpine energy!
beschreibung: The Café Sport in Innsbruck in the Innsbruck region is an energetic and welcoming café where sports enthusiasts and casual guests meet. Serving excellent coffee, cold beverages, and tasty snacks, it offers a vibrant yet cozy setting for sharing conversations, unwinding after active excursions, or simply enjoying friendly hospitality.
